purpose: One row per finished game: date, both teams, final score, and the quarter line score. The quarter scores exist so a total can be settled properly (a game that went to overtime, or one decided after three quarters, is not the same bet) and so the second-half / game-flow work has a real number rather than a narrative.
verification_rule: Every row below was read TWICE from two different official surfaces of the same nba.com data: the schedule page (which prints just the final) and the game page (which prints the Q1-Q4 line score). A row is only accepted when the two agree AND the four quarter values sum to the final on each side. The sums are checked arithmetically by scripts/results_feed.py, not by eye.

coverage.games_with_final_only_source: data/origin/games.csv (the 183-game log through 2026-11-13, captured by earlier sessions from the official scoreboard)
coverage.why_the_older_games_have_no_quarters: Quarter scores were never captured for 2026-10-20 .. 2026-11-13. Filling them would mean re-reading 183 game pages, and until that is done they are recorded as null. They are NOT reconstructed from the final: a quarter split cannot be derived from a final score.
